summary: Pre-market, 2026-09-07. The composite risk score eased for a second day to 42.74 (-0.43 on the day), still in caution, with the regime reading goldilocks on low volatility, positive momentum and repaired breadth. The easing came from the macro block: the 10Y yield fell to 4.77 from 4.79, the 2Y to 4.34 from 4.39, and the 10Y real rate to 2.42 from 2.45 - still the 98.16th percentile, so restrictive, just less so. VIX dropped to 14.32 from 15.2 and realised vol sits at 8.1061, while MA200 breadth recovered to 0.6258. What does not confirm: the dollar firmed to 118.7479, gold was bid, bitcoin fell to 79405.0 and cyclicals trailed defensives, leaving cross-asset confirmation at 0.625 with 7 of 10 signals triggered. Policy is still priced as a hike - fed funds futures imply 3.94 against an effective rate of 3.63 - after payrolls surprised at 162.0 versus 21.0 previously. Overnight the AI trade rotated inside itself rather than de-rating: memory +6.9663 and semiconductor equipment +5.1904 led (MU +6.0982, AMD +4.6935, NVDA +0.8361) while AI software fell -3.8292 and enterprise software -2.2253, and autos dropped -5.9223 with TSLA -5.9224. The CN close was uniformly strong: all 11 A-share names in the panel finished higher, led by 300475.SZ +7.2793 and 688825.SH +6.6971. The binaries this week are PPI on 2026-09-10 and CPI on 2026-09-11; a firm CPI against a market pricing 3.94 is the cleanest path back to macro-led stress. Note that the Chinese-language wires in this feed arrive via an RSSHub relay and are second-hand aggregation.

top_risk_drivers.claim: Restrictive real rates still anchor the macro block: the 10Y real rate is 2.42 at the 98.16th percentile, with the 10Y at 4.77 and the 2Y at 4.34, keeping the macro dimension the largest contributor at 62.28 even as it cools.

Policy is priced for a hike, not a cut: fed funds futures imply 3.94 against an effective funds rate of 3.63, and payrolls printed 162.0 versus 21.0 previously, so the labour market is not forcing the Fed's hand.

The cross-asset tape does not confirm the equity improvement: cross-asset confirmation sits at 0.625, the dollar index is 118.7479, bitcoin is 79405.0 and gold is bid, while cyclicals trail defensives.
Leadership is narrow and the internal tape is stretched: semis relative is -8.1141, new highs 0.0194 against new lows 0.0129, and small caps at 0.6731 - index-level calm is not broad participation.
The rate path is the live risk into CPI: with the 10Y at 4.77 and the 2Y at 4.34, a firm print on 2026-09-11 re-arms the macro block, and the market gets PPI on 2026-09-10 first.

supporting_signals.claim: Volatility has collapsed: VIX is 14.32 from 15.2 and realised vol 8.1061, leaving the volatility dimension at 13.34 - the clearest single de-risking in the composite.
Breadth repaired materially: 0.6258 above the MA200, price 8.1495 above the MA200, 3M momentum 4.4255 and a 52W drawdown of only -0.9886.
Credit refuses to confirm stress: HY OAS 2.65 from 2.66 and IG OAS 0.81, with the HY-widening signal untriggered.
Disinflation is intact: CPI 3.30386 from 3.46353 and core CPI 2.46652 from 2.56579, with both breakevens flat at 2.33 and 2.35 - no second-round impulse.
The AI hardware bid is broadening: memory +6.9663, semiconductor equipment +5.1904, semiconductors +3.5165, networking +2.8242 and data centers +1.8788, with MU +6.0982 and AMD +4.6935.

contradicting_signals.claim: The dollar is firming, not easing: 118.7479 from 118.3583, which tightens global financial conditions even as US yields fall.
Liquidity plumbing is thin: reverse repo at 0.675 from 0.702 and reserves at 2894531.0, so any funding shock has a smaller buffer.
Policy is tightening into a cooling inflation impulse: implied 3.94 against 3.63 effective means the drop in nominal yields is a market move, not a Fed move.
The rotation is violent inside the tape: autos -5.9223 with TSLA -5.9224 and AI software -3.8292, against memory +6.9663 - dispersion, not a clean risk-on.
Semis relative at -8.1141 says the AI leadership is not confirmed by the equal-weighted complex, and new highs of 0.0194 are thin for a market 8.1495 above the MA200.

bull_case.title: Bull case: disinflation plus collapsing volatility re-opens the goldilocks trade
points: CPI 3.30386 and core CPI 2.46652 keep cooling; a soft print on 2026-09-11 fades the 3.94 hike and lets the 10Y extend lower from 4.77.
Breadth at 0.6258 with price 8.1495 above the MA200 and VIX at 14.32 leaves room for the equity structure block to keep improving.
Memory +6.9663, semiconductor equipment +5.1904 and networking +2.8242 say the AI bid is broadening rather than narrowing.

base_case.title: Base case: the composite grinds sideways in caution as macro cools and cross-asset stays uneasy
points: Risk holds near 42.74 as the macro block eases with the 2Y at 4.34, while cross-asset confirmation stays at 0.625.
Dispersion persists: memory +6.9663 against autos -5.9223 and AI software -3.8292, with TSLA -5.9224.
Vol stays contained with VIX 14.32 and realised vol 8.1061, and HY OAS 2.65 keeps credit from confirming stress.

bear_case.title: Bear case: a firm CPI against a market pricing 3.94 re-arms macro and breaks the rotation
points: Payrolls at 162.0 versus 21.0 and implied 3.94 above the 3.63 effective rate keep the hike path live; a hot CPI on 2026-09-11 pushes the 10Y back toward 4.79 and beyond.
A dollar at 118.7479 with bitcoin at 79405.0 and cyclicals trailing defensives is the configuration that turns a narrow AI bid into a broad de-rating.
Reverse repo at 0.675 and a 98.16th-percentile real rate of 2.42 mean the shock absorber is thinner than the 42.74 score implies.
